# Third-party components

- PySide6 Essentials / shiboken6 / Qt 6.11.2: LGPL-3.0 / GPL alternatives; source https://code.qt.io/cgit/pyside/pyside-setup.git/tag/?h=v6.11.2 and https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtbase.git/tag/?h=v6.11.2. Additional Qt components/plugins retain their upstream notices. Shared libraries can be replaced in `_internal/PySide6`; the application imposes no restriction on modification or reverse engineering for debugging those libraries.
- psutil 7.2.2: BSD-3-Clause, source https://github.com/giampaolo/psutil/tree/release-7.2.2.
- PyInstaller 6.22.3 bootloader: GPL with distribution exception, source https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/tree/v6.22.3.
- Noto Sans SC: SIL OFL 1.1, source https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc.
- Python 3 runtime: PSF license, https://www.python.org/psf/license/; runtime license included in distribution.

Full applicable license texts are included alongside this notice. Character artwork has separate terms in ASSETS.md.
